true：启动成功。
false：启动失败。| |eventType|String|是|事件类型。| |customSessionId|String|是|自定义会话ID。| |platformSessionId|String|是|平台会话ID。| |customTaskId|String|否|自定义任务ID。| |platformTaskId|String|否|平台任务ID。| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|是|事件详情。| |errorMessage|Object[EventDetail]|否|错误详情。

descriptions.en:
- After a session is created successfully, the event type is `APP_START`. The result of application startup is notified through the following message. >Available only in API integration mode and not applicable to H5 SDK integration mode.> |Name | Type | Required |Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | | success | Boolean | Yes |Indicates whether the startup succeeded.
Valid values:
true: Startup succeeded.
false: Startup failed.| |eventType|String|Yes|Event type.| |customSessionId|String|Yes|Custom session ID.| |platformSessionId|String|Yes|Platform session ID.| |customTaskId|String|No|Custom task ID.| |platformTaskId|String|No|Platform task ID.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|Yes|Event details.| |errorMessage|Object[EventDetail]|No|Error Details.
This parameter is returned when startup fails.| |tags|Map|No|Session labels.| The data structure of EventDetail is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |appId|String|Yes|Application ID.| |appVersion|String|Yes|Application Version ID.| |appBizConfig|String|No|Custom business configuration data used during platform adaptation.| |streamingToken|String|No|Streaming authentication information. This field is included only when a streaming service exists.| |endpoint|Object[Endpoint]|No|Event details.
This parameter is returned when startup succeeds.| The data structure of Endpoint is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |-------|-------|-------|-------| |name|String|Yes|Name.| |type|String|Yes|Type.| |accessHost|String|Yes|Endpoint IP address.| |accessPort|String|Yes|Endpoint port.| |isp|String|Yes|
Carrier identity.
Valid values:
MOBILE: China Mobile.
UNICOM: China Unicom.
TELECOM: China Telecom.
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).| |districtId|String|Yes|Area ID.| |regionId|String|Yes|Region ID.| The data structure of ErrorMessage is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|Yes|Error code.| |msg|String|Yes|Error Details.| - After a session involving streaming is created successfully, the event type is `APP_STREAMING_INIT`. Streaming initialization information is notified through the following message. >Available only in API integration mode and not applicable to H5 SDK integration mode.> | Name | Type | Required |Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | | success | Boolean | Yes |Indicates whether streaming initialization succeeded.
Valid values:
true: Initialization succeeded.
false: Initialization failed.| |eventType|String|Yes|Event type.| |customSessionId|String|Yes|Custom session ID.| |platformSessionId|String|Yes|Platform session ID.| |customTaskId|String|No|Custom task ID.| |platformTaskId|String|No|Platform task ID.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|Yes|Event details.| The data structure of EventDetail is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |appId|String|Yes|Application ID.| |appVersion|String|Yes|Application Version ID.| |appBizConfig|String|No|Custom business configuration data used during platform adaptation.| |streamingToken|String|No|Streaming authentication information. This field is included only when a streaming service exists.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|No|Event details.
This parameter is returned when session startup succeeds.| |errorMessage|Object|No|Error Details.
This parameter is returned when session startup fails.| The data structure of Endpoint is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |-------|-------|-------|-------| |name|String|Yes|Name.| |type|String|Yes|Type.| |accessHost|String|Yes|Endpoint IP address.| |accessPort|String|Yes|Endpoint port.| |isp|String|Yes|
Carrier identity.
Valid values:
MOBILE: China Mobile.
UNICOM: China Unicom.
TELECOM: China Telecom.
BGP: Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).| |districtId|String|Yes|Area ID.| |regionId|String|Yes|Region ID.| The data structure of ErrorMessage is as follows. |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|Yes|Error code.| |msg|String|Yes|Error Details.|
